hero.title: Our Mission
hero.body: CampusMind is a student-led initiative at IIUM that supports your mental wellness journey through daily self-care tasks, curated resources, and easy access to professional help. We believe every student deserves a calm mind and a place to turn to when things feel heavy.

info.title: Our Vision
info.body: A campus where every student feels seen, supported, and equipped with tools to thrive academically and emotionally.

info.title: Our Values
info.body: Compassion, confidentiality, inclusivity, and evidence-based care guide everything we do.

info.title: Who We Help
info.body: All IIUM students from undergraduate, postgraduate, local and international across every campus.

info.title: What We Do
info.body: We provide self-help resources, wellness tracking, and direct lines to IIUM's counseling services.
